title: Supported DID Identification Pilot Fixture
abstract: This fixture represents a DID environmental policy paper with explicit evidence across ARGUS identification dimensions.

sections.parallel trends: The event-study pre-trend coefficients are near zero and support parallel trends; placebo pre-period estimates are also null.
sections.no anticipation: No anticipation is supported by the timeline of announcement and implementation; event-study leads are null.
sections.treatment timing: Staggered adoption is handled with Callaway-Sant'Anna, Sun-Abraham, and a Goodman-Bacon decomposition for heterogeneous effects.
sections.sutva: SUTVA and interference are assessed with spillover robustness, buffer-zone checks, and leakage sensitivity.
sections.control group: A balance table shows matched controls; the donor pool is justified with matching and synthetic control checks.
sections.specification: The specification robustness table varies fixed effects, controls, and functional form choices.
sections.inference: Standard errors are clustered by province, with wild-cluster bootstrap robustness for serial correlation.
sections.sample period: Sample period and time-window sensitivity checks vary start period, end period, and unbalanced panel handling.
sections.concurrent policies: Concurrent policies are enumerated; policy controls and placebo periods isolate the studied policy.
sections.robustness placebo: Placebo-in-time, placebo-in-space, falsification tests, permutation checks, and randomization inference are reported.
sections.data measurement: The data source documents definition stability, missingness handling, and measurement consistency over time.
